title: PR 181 paste: moved photo lines follow the block holding the paste point in the post-paste text
context: notePasteTransaction pasted photo lines inline when the selection ended in a separator or on a photo line (S5, P6). The reviewer's fix, the block holding selection.start in the original tree, can end inside the deleted range and produce overlapping replacements.
options: block holding selection.end in the original tree (old behaviour)
block holding selection.start in the original tree
block holding selection.start in the pasted result with photo lines removed, else the nearest preceding block, else the note start (P3 rule 2)
outcome:
The third option (commit 375b55b). It never produces overlapping replacements, and it matches _photoLinesLand's rule that photo lines must not split a text block of that result. 'Hello world

Next' with 5..12 selected and a photo pasted gives 'Hello
Next
![p](...)'. One behaviour changed: when the pasted text itself contains a paragraph break, the photo lands after the block holding the caret, not after the last pasted block.
